auditor_value: (a) 4 kg: fs,max = 24 N > 20 N, so a = 0 and f = 20 N (static); (b) 2 kg: fs,max = 12 N < 20 N, so it slides, f = 0.4 x 2 x 10 = 8 N, a = (20 - 8)/2 = 6 m/s^2
notes: Answer agrees. The question does not fix g; the solution uses g = 10 visibly in each equation (with 9.8 the conclusions are the same: 23.5 N > 20 N at rest; 7.84 N and 6.08 m/s^2 sliding). Both common-mistake numbers (16 N and 1 m/s^2; 4 m/s^2) follow from their stated causes.
